heading: Liji 7 · Li Yun 禮運 · Ceremonial Usages; Their Origin, Development, And Intention · Li Yun II.13 … Li Yun III.8

items.text: Show kindness to your son.
items.quote: Kindness on the part of the father

items.text: Practice filial duty toward your father.
items.quote: filial duty on that of the son

items.text: Be gentle with your younger brother.
items.quote: gentleness on the part of the elder brother

items.text: Obey your elder brother.
items.quote: obedience on that of the younger

items.text: Treat your wife with righteousness.
items.quote: righteousness on the part of the husband

items.text: Submit to your husband.
items.quote: submission on that of the wife

items.text: Show kindness to your juniors.
items.quote: kindness on the part of elders

items.text: Defer to your elders.
items.quote: deference on that of juniors

work: Ceremonial Usages; Their Origin, Development, And Intention
heading: Liji 7 · Li Yun 禮運 · Ceremonial Usages; Their Origin, Development, And Intention · Li Yun III.9 … Li Yun IV.11

items.text: In the ancestral temple, discharge the services of filial duty and kindly affection toward the departed ancestors.
items.quote: By means of those in the ancestral temple, the services of filial duty and of kindly affection come to be discharged.

items.text: Bury the dead and serve the spirits of the departed as the rules of ceremony prescribe.
items.quote: They constitute the great methods by which we nourish the living, bury the dead, and serve the spirits of the departed.

work: Ceremonial Usages; Their Origin, Development, And Intention
heading: Liji 7 · Li Yun 禮運 · Ceremonial Usages; Their Origin, Development, And Intention · Li Yun IV.12 … Li Yun IV.16

items.text: Show generous affection to your son.
items.quote: There is generous affection between father and son

items.text: Show generous affection to your father.
items.quote: There is generous affection between father and son

items.text: Maintain harmony with your siblings.
items.quote: harmony between brothers

items.text: Keep a happy union with your wife.
items.quote: happy union between husband and wife

items.text: Keep a happy union with your husband.
items.quote: happy union between husband and wife

items.text: Bury the dead.
items.quote: the burial of the dead

items.text: Serve the spirits of the departed.
items.quote: the service of the spirits (of the departed)
items.conflict: Worship God alone; do not serve or pray to the dead (Deut. 18:10-12; 26:14).

work: Ceremonial Usages; Their Origin, Development, And Intention
heading: Liji 7 · Li Yun 禮運 · Ceremonial Usages; Their Origin, Development, And Intention · Li Yun I.1 … Li Yun I.9

items.text: Maintain a community of sentiment between husband and wife.
items.quote: in a community of sentiment that between husband and wife

items.text: Regard your son generously, as propriety requires the father-son relation to be marked by generous regard.
items.quote: in its generous regard that between father and son

items.text: Maintain harmony with your younger sibling.
items.quote: in its harmony that between elder brother and younger

items.text: Ensure the aged are competently provided for until death.
items.quote: A competent provision was secured for the aged till their death

items.text: Show kindness and compassion to widows, seeing that they are sufficiently maintained.
items.quote: They showed kindness and compassion to widows, orphans, childless men, and those who were disabled by disease, so that they were all sufficiently maintained.

items.text: Show kindness and compassion to orphans, securing the means for them to grow up.
items.quote: They showed kindness and compassion to widows, orphans, childless men, and those who were disabled by disease, so that they were all sufficiently maintained.

items.text: Make offerings to the dead and serve the spirits of the departed.
items.quote: to make offerings to the dead; to serve the spirits of the departed and God
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worshiping God alone.

items.text: When a kinsman dies, call back his soul, place rice in his mouth, and set out offerings.
items.quote: they went upon the housetop, and called out his name in a prolonged note, saying, 'Come back, So and So.'
items.conflict: Calling back the soul and offerings to the dead conflict with Deut. 18:11 and the first commandment.

work: Ceremonial Usages; Their Origin, Development, And Intention
heading: Liji 7 · Li Yun 禮運 · Ceremonial Usages; Their Origin, Development, And Intention · Li Yun I.10 … Li Yun II.12

items.text: Maintain a generous feeling toward your son.
items.quote: maintain the generous feeling between father and son

items.text: Maintain a generous feeling toward your father.
items.quote: maintain the generous feeling between father and son

items.text: Maintain harmony with your younger sibling.
items.quote: the harmony between elder and younger brother

items.text: Maintain harmony with your elder sibling.
items.quote: the harmony between elder and younger brother

items.text: Give your wife her proper place in the household.
items.quote: give their proper places to husband and wife

items.text: Give your husband his proper place in the household.
items.quote: give their proper places to husband and wife

items.text: Offer the sacrifices with prayers that express filial piety, to please the souls of your departed ancestors.
items.quote: prayers which express the filial piety... all being done to please the souls of the departed

items.text: Do not send a clan member who is in mourning for a parent or newly married on any mission for a year.
items.quote: who is in mourning for a parent, or has newly married, is not sent on any mission for a year

items.text: Settle your sons and grandsons in your domain, as the statutory arrangement.
items.quote: the son of Heaven has his domain that he may settle there his sons and grandsons
